description: Only when no signed-up Sirfus business fits the work and place: up to 3 businesses from public listings, each with where it was found, its public phone and website, a rating only when Google gave one, and availability only when known ("we'll confirm a time" otherwise). CAR contacts none of them and shares nothing about the person. Legal work is not listed; health work is listed by distance, not ranked. Returns a searchId for car_pick_outside.

category.description: Optional. A category slug from /v1/categories that the person picked, for example after a needs_detail question. Without it, CAR reads the request.

where.description: City and two-letter US state, e.g. "Tampa, FL"

name: car_find_outside
title: Find businesses outside the network
